newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on a live basis, compared to Friday's close, USDA said. Trade was very slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Friday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers not tested.

Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales. Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 2 ld 98.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 100.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 98.00.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
